description: This is a Java source file defining an Android Activity class 'MyRssReader3' that functions as an RSS feed reader. It manages a list of RSS items, displays them in a ListView with custom styling, and handles menu options for starting/stopping services, adding, deleting, or updating RSS items.

classes.name: MyRssReader3
classes.description: An Android Activity that functions as an RSS feed reader, displaying RSS items in a list, with options to add, delete, update, and control services.

classes.name: MyRssReader3.RssDataAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter subclass for rendering RSS items with special formatting for unread items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads layout, populates RSS list, and sets up ListView adapter.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current list selection state before activity is potentially destroyed.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates menu options for starting/stopping service, adding, deleting, and updating RSS items.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, potentially enabling/disabling items based on state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles user interactions with menu items, triggering appropriate actions.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Processes results from the activity used to add new RSS items.

methods.description: Creates and returns the initial list of RSS items.
